ACE Music Free (LITE) v1.0.0

- Initial release of the ACE Music基础版, powered by the ACE-Step 1.5 model.
- Supports three core features: text-to-music generation, custom lyric integration, and instrumental (no vocals) mode.
- No subscription required; API is permanently free for personal and prototyping use.
- Output delivered as base64-encoded MP3, with built-in scripts for decoding and file output.
- Requires manual API Key configuration via environment variable for use.
- Scope limited to basic text-to-music use; no cover, repaint, batch, or BPM/key control in this version.
